["No held source dates the end of the President's Commission on Housing, whose parent order EO 12310 Sec. 4(b) says 'shall terminate upon presenting its final report and recommendations' (report due April 30, 1982); EO 12339 only raises the membership ceiling in Sec. 1(a) of EO 12310. EO 12399 Sec. 4(g) revoked EO 12310 effective 1982-12-31 (its Sec. 6) as one of the orders that 'established committees which have terminated or whose work is completed', which bounds the end at 1982-12-31 but is a cleanup revocation, not a first end. Needed: a held source for the date the Commission's final report was presented (the Report of the President's Commission on Housing, April 1982, with its transmittal date, or a White House record of its receipt), or a source that the Commission otherwise ceased. Bound only: ended no later than 1982-12-31."]

["No held source dates the end of the Senate Special Committee To Investigate Organized Crime in Interstate Commerce (Senate Resolution 202, 81st Congress, as extended) or otherwise shows when the inspection authority in this amendment of EO 10132 was exhausted. Needed: the Senate resolution text or committee final-report/expiry record, or an order revoking or superseding EO 10132. Held leads: the 1989 OFR table records 'Executed and obsolete'; later-events and current-law searches have no hit. EO 10280 (held) is a different order printed on the same Federal Register page."]

["No held source dates the submission of the report of the emergency board created by EO 12563 (Sec. 4: the board 'shall terminate upon the submission of the report'; Sec. 2 deadlines are report deadlines, not ends). The eumenes-nmb-reports job holds no entry for this board, and National Mediation Board report PDFs are custody_record_only in any case. Needed: the board's report with its transmittal date held as bytes, or a Federal Register notice of the report."]

["No held source shows when the amended paragraph 2 of EO 9070 (the National Housing Administrator's appointment clause, salary words deleted) ceased. Reorganization Plan No. 3 of 1947 (61 Stat. 954, effective July 27, 1947; held as jobs/selden-statutes/output/texts/STATUTE-61-Pg954.txt) consolidates housing agencies into the Housing and Home Finance Agency and refers in its Sec. 7 to 'the existing National Housing Agency', but nothing in it expressly abolishes the National Housing Agency or EO 9070, and no other held text does. The 1989 OFR table says 'Authority repealed by Pub. L. 89-554 (80 Stat. 651, 50 U.S.C. App. 601-605 nt.)'. Needed: the statute or order that abolished the National Housing Agency and its Administrator (or the First War Powers Act Title I expiry text on which EO 9070 rested), with its effective date."]

["Text of Public Land Order 678 (October 24, 1950; 15 FR 7299) is not held, so its scope, effective date and effect on the 126,720-acre withdrawal cannot be read. The OFR note 'Revoked by: Public Land Order 678, October 24, 1950 (15 FR 7299)' and the 1989 OFR table ('Revoked by PLO 678') are held only as editorial notes, and the file the dossier names for the acting text (jobs/selden-fr-acting/output/texts/FR_15_9161.txt) is Federal Register page 9161 of December 21, 1950, which does not contain the order. Needed: 15 FR 7299 (Federal Register issue of about October 1950) with the full text of PLO 678. EO 9526 (February 28, 1945; 10 FR 2423) lists EO 9053 among orders it amends and is held, but it is an amendment, not an end. Bound only: the withdrawal was formally revoked by PLO 678 dated 1950-10-24 per the OFR note; first end unresolved."]

["Two instruments that bear on the lifecycle are cited but not held as evidence: Public Land Order 284 (June 12, 1945), which PLO 827 and PLO 2437 recite as having amended EO 9153-A, and the text of Public Land Order 1087 (March 8, 1955; 20 FR 1560), which partially revoked it (PLO 2437 recites both). Their effect on the lands and effective dates cannot be read, so the amendment/partial-revocation chain is incomplete. The dossier inventory is also faulty: its lead segment runs through unrelated Federal Register contents pages and omits Tracts 2 and 3, the revocation of EO 8789 as to part of Tract 1 and the confidentiality command released by the Secretary of War's letter of June 27, 1946. Bound only: PLO 2437 (July 18, 1961; 26 FR 6591) revoked EO 9153-A 'in its entirety' (held), after PLO 827 (May 16, 1952) revoked it as to Tract No. 3."]

["No held source shows when the federal military force and Michigan National Guard called out by this order were withdrawn or released (Sec. 3: 'for an indefinite period and until relieved by appropriate orders'). Needed: a held source for the withdrawal of federal troops and release of the Michigan Guard from active federal service in July-August 1967 (for example the Army Center of Military History study 'The Role of Federal Military Forces in Domestic Disorders, 1945-1992', Detroit chapter; the held excerpt covers only PDF pages 1-40 and not Detroit), or a proclamation or order terminating the Proclamation 3795 emergency. Held leads: the 1989 OFR table records 'Executed and obsolete'."]

["No held source dates the end of possession, control and operation of the Great Lakes Towing Company's system under this order (Sec. 4: terminated by the Director of the Office of Defense Transportation when he determines it is no longer needed). The 1989 OFR table records 'Authority terminated by act of June 29, 1946 (60 Stat. 341, 50 U.S.C. App. 316 nt.)', but the text of that Act is not held (no STATUTE-60-Pg341 granule in jobs/selden-statutes), and the actual end may have been earlier. Needed: the Office of Defense Transportation order or notice returning the company (Federal Register, December 1945 to 1946), and the text of the Act of June 29, 1946 (60 Stat. 341)."]

["The first end of every clause except the uniformed-services schedule cannot be given as an exact date from held evidence in the packet. EO 13970 Sec. 8 says EO 13901 'is superseded as of the effective dates specified in section 7 of this order' (signed 2020-12-31); Sec. 7 makes Schedule 8 effective January 1, 2021 and the other schedules effective on 'the first day of the first applicable pay period beginning on or after January 1, 2021', which varies with the pay system. The OPM notice (FR Doc. 2021-08656, Federal Register of April 26, 2021) states January 3, 2021 for locality payments, but it is not among the packet's citable evidence and does not state the date for each pay system. Needed: held evidence of the pay-period start date for each schedule's pay system (or an OPM pay-period calendar) added to the packet as citable evidence. Bound: superseded no later than the first applicable pay period beginning on or after 2021-01-01; Schedule 8 (Sec. 4) ended 2021-01-01."]

Held lead: the 1989 OFR table records 'Temporary'."]

["The order cannot be submitted as inventoried. Ends differ by clause: Sec. 1 was revoked by EO 10433 Sec. 1(c) (signed 1953-02-04; held); Sec. 2(b) by EO 10281 Sec. 405(c) (1951-08-28; held); the rest by EO 10480 Sec. 607 (signed 1953-08-14; held), with amendments by EOs 10219, 10223, 10301, 10324, 10359, 10373, 10377, 10390, 10433 and 10461 that have not been read clause by clause. Needed: a corrected clause inventory and a clause-by-clause reading of those held later orders. Bound: formally superseded or revoked by EO 10480 on 1953-08-14."]
